anomalies.observed: On the Motion Sensing page the three I2C peripherals U10 (LSM6DS3), U33 (LIS3MDL) and U52 (ADS1115) have their SDA pin wired to NET0126 while their SCL pin is wired to NET0011. On the CM4/I-O page, however, the I2C bus SDA net is NET0128: the GPIO expander U21 (PCA9536D) SDA = NET0128, the OLED header J37 SDA = NET0128, and the I2C pull-up R44 (10K to 3.3V_PI_OUT) is on NET0128 (SCL pull-up R16 on NET0011). So SCL is shared (NET0011) but SDA is split into two nets, and the sensors' SDA (NET0126) carries no pull-up and is not the net the master/expander sit on.
anomalies.expected: All devices on a single I2C bus must share both the SDA and the SCL net (with the pull-ups on the same SDA net the master drives). The motion-sensing/ADC chips' SDA should be on NET0128, the same net as U21, J37 and the R44 pull-up, not on a separate NET0126.

evidence.quote: Motion Sensing page: U10 LSM6DS3 'SDA NET0126 / SCL NET0011'; U33 LIS3MDL 'SDA/SDI NET0126 / SCL/SPC NET0011'; U52 ADS1115 'SDA NET0126 / SCL NET0011'
CM4/I/O page: U21 PCA9536D 'SDA NET0128, SCL NET0011'; I2C pull-ups R16 10K to NET0011 and R44 10K to NET0128; OLED J37 'NET0128 / NET0011'
the board actually implements ... an RTC ... and I2C peripherals on the CM4 carrier (power distribution / compute carrier section)

anomalies.impact: The IMU (U10), magnetometer (U33) and input-voltage ADC (U52) are not connected to the I2C SDA line the CM4 and pull-ups drive, so they cannot be addressed; motion sensing and input-voltage reading over I2C fail while the SCL line is still toggled.

parsed.summary: The build otherwise matches the described architecture (16 MHz CAN crystals, /OE-gated SN74LVC1G07 e-stop sinks feeding the CAN connectors, LTC4412 ideal-diode USB path, ISL54222 analog switches, WS2812B chain), but the I2C SDA net is inconsistent: U10/U33/U52 sit on NET0126 while the bus SDA, its pull-up and the other I2C devices sit on NET0128 with a shared NET0011 SCL, leaving the motion/ADC chips disconnected from the I2C bus.
